Mystical forest with exaggerated VERTICAL SCALE - towering ancient trees reaching dramatic heights. Design: procedurally deformed terrain (SubdivideSurface on Box), 3 distinct tree archetypes (Spiral/Twist cones, Crystal/Ellipsoid spires, Canopy/Cylinder+Sphere giants), scattered via ScatterOnSurface with per-type count variation. Parametric: terrainSize drives everything, treeHeight_base with multipliers per type, roughness controls terrain relief. ~18 nodes for dense forest.
